D5/S3/QuadraticForms/CycleRankThreePsdCo.name: D5.S3.QuadraticForms.CycleRankThreePsdCompletion.cycle_rank_three_iff
D5/S3/QuadraticForms/CycleRankThreePsdCo.signature: theorem cycle_rank_three_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, -1 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ 1) : (∃ B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, B.PosSemidef ∧ B.rank ≤ 3 ∧ (∀ i, B i i = 1) ∧ ∀ i, B i (finRotate n i) = a i) ↔ ∀ F : Finset (Fin n), Odd F.card → (∑ i ∈ F, arccos (a i)) - (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ F, arccos (a i)) ≤ ((F.card : ℝ) - 1) * π
